title: .agents/state/pending-confirmation.json (files a headless /agentive:init or /agentive:update skipped)
description: A run with no human present (no_human_run, revised 2026-10-27: AGENTIVE_HEADLESS=1, CI or GITHUB_ACTIONS, or permission_mode dontAsk in hook input that carries it; CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is not a signal; no signal = interactive; headless init and update read the environment signals) writes the files outside U2 confirm_scope and records the skipped confirm_scope files here; the next interactive SessionStart shows a notice and the agent writes them after the human approves (decided 2026-10-16).

rendered_sha256.description: hash of the content that would have been written, so the approval applies to exactly that content
